details:
As you may know, I fix things that are broken on VRC processes, one of such is using the Moderation Events to detect Trolling Behavior.  For example when I see a user get kicked more 2 times per day in multiple group instances, I am fairly certain they are Trolling.  By applying 'circuit breaking' rules listening on the Kafka event topic of moderation events, you can effectively sideline the trolls or apply 'Listen In Monitors' to their sessions, collecting evidence for them to be Perma-Banned with a Trust and Safety review.

This should put the fear into the trolls and crashers as a analytics moderator, we create profiles of the worst of the worst in VRC.  

For example I know that the top one is a alt account for a known troll, oh the linkage I could do with a few simple changes to the VRC database and collection system....

It's time to clean the roster VRC, it would be nice to just be able to chat, but we are spending a lot of time cleaning up after bad policies.
title: Auto-Moderation for Trolls
